title: N. IGS./WI.UU. OX/W. OKS. MH/Y. IM
html_source:
reversed alphabetic where A=Z, B=Y, C=X, etc.
all vowels are represented by dots
boustrophedontic where the first line reads left to right, second line reads right to left, etc.

N.IGS. translates to M.RTH.
WI.UU.OX translates to DR.FF.LC
W.OKS.MH translates to D.LPH.NS
Y.IM translates to B.RN although it seems that it should be reversed (MI.Y) like the second line
